english: Let $p$, $q$ and $r$ be real numbers such that no two of the planes
have a common point, and the origin is equidistant from $P_1$ and $P_3$. Then the distance between the two of these planes that are nearest to each other is ______.
hindi: माना कि $p$, $q$ तथा $r$ ऐसी वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं कि तलों
में से किन्हीं दो का कोई उभयनिष्ठ बिन्दु नहीं है, तथा मूलबिन्दु $P_1$ तथा $P_3$ से समदूरस्थ है। तब इन तलों में से एक-दूसरे के निकटतम दो तलों के बीच की दूरी ______ है।
solution: Two planes with no common point are parallel and distinct, so all three normals are proportional to $(1,2,2)$
Planes: $x+2y+2z=1$, $x+2y+2z=\frac52$, $x+2y+2z=\frac r4$ (the system has no solution)
Equidistant origin: $\left|\frac r4\right|=1$; $\frac r4=1$ would make $P_3=P_1$, so $\frac r4=-1$
solution_full: If two planes have no common point they are parallel and distinct. So $P_2$ and $P_3$ are both parallel to $P_1$, whose normal is $(1,2,2)$.
$P_2$: $(2,p,4)$ must be a multiple of $(1,2,2)$; the first and third components give the factor $2$, so $p=4$. Then $P_2$ is $x+2y+2z=\frac52$, distinct from $P_1$.
The three planes are parallel, so the system of the three equations has no solution, and they are pairwise disjoint provided $\frac r4\ne1$ and $\frac r4\ne\frac52$.

Distance of the origin from $x+2y+2z=c$ is $\dfrac{|c|}{3}$. Equidistance from $P_1$ and $P_3$: $\dfrac13=\dfrac{|r/4|}{3}$, so $\frac r4=\pm1$. The value $\frac r4=1$ makes $P_3$ coincide with $P_1$, which is excluded; hence $\frac r4=-1$, $r=-4$.
The planes are $x+2y+2z=c$ with $c=-1,\ 1,\ \frac52$. Distances between parallel planes are $\dfrac{|c_1-c_2|}{3}$: $\frac23$ for $(-1,1)$, $\frac12$ for $(1,\frac52)$, $\frac76$ for $(-1,\frac52)$.
The nearest pair is $P_1$ and $P_2$, at distance $\frac12=0.5$.
originality_note: New: three planes fixed only by the condition that no two meet (so the system is inconsistent with all planes parallel), with the free constant settled by an equidistance condition that has a spurious root (way 5). Closest known: conditions on coefficients for three parallel planes, distance between parallel planes. Different because: the coincident-plane root must be rejected, and the question compares three distances.
blueprint_concepts: Solving system of linear equations when all three planes are parallel and disjoint

concept_use.Solving system of linear equations when: 'No two planes have a common point' forces all three to be parallel and distinct; this fixes p = 4, q = 8 and rejects r = 4.

stem_review: Read as a student: p, q, r real; 'no two have a common point' means pairwise disjoint; 'nearest to each other' compares the three pairs; r is unique after rejecting the coincident case. Checked distances 1/2, 2/3, 7/6. Answer 0.50, a decimal between 0 and 1 as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Pairwise disjoint planes are parallel; the equidistance root that makes P3 = P1 is rejected.
justification: Routine chain of parallel-plane conditions and distances, with one rejection step; no new idea. Comparable to 2024-P2-Q6 (L1) and 2026-P2-Q1 (L2); L2.
